skills.name: Drawing
skills.description: Making images with pencil, pen, charcoal or markers on paper.
skills.pitch: The simplest way to start: one pencil, any paper, five minutes.

skills.name: Sketching
skills.description: Quick, loose drawing to capture ideas, people and places.
skills.pitch: Like drawing, but faster and messier — on purpose.

skills.name: Doodling
skills.description: Playful, free-form drawing of patterns and little characters.
skills.pitch: Drawing without a plan. Perfect for the margins of your day.

skills.name: Hand lettering
skills.description: Drawing decorative letters and words by hand.
skills.pitch: Turn a favorite quote into something you'd frame.

skills.name: Calligraphy
skills.description: The art of beautiful writing with a broad nib or brush pen.
skills.pitch: Slow, rhythmic strokes that make plain words look special.

skills.name: Watercolor
skills.description: Painting with transparent, water-based paint on paper.
skills.pitch: Let the water do half the work and enjoy the happy accidents.

skills.name: Gouache
skills.description: Painting with opaque, matte water-based paint.
skills.pitch: Like watercolor, but you can paint light over dark.

skills.name: Acrylic painting
skills.description: Painting with fast-drying, water-based acrylic paint.
skills.pitch: Bold colors, quick layers and very forgiving mistakes.

skills.name: Coloring
skills.description: Filling printed line art with color using pencils, pens or markers.
skills.pitch: A calm, no-pressure way to play with color combinations.

skills.name: Mandala art
skills.description: Drawing or painting circular, symmetrical patterns.
skills.pitch: Repeat one shape around a centre and watch it bloom.

skills.name: Crochet
skills.description: Making fabric from yarn with a single hook.
skills.pitch: One hook, one loop at a time — scarves, toys, coasters and more.

skills.name: Amigurumi
skills.description: Crocheting small stuffed toys and characters.
skills.pitch: Like crochet, but everything turns into tiny friends.

skills.name: Knitting
skills.description: Making fabric from yarn with two needles.
skills.pitch: Steady, repeatable stitches that turn into cozy things to wear.

skills.name: Embroidery
skills.description: Decorating fabric with needle and thread stitches.
skills.pitch: Paint with thread — start with one flower in a hoop.

skills.name: Cross-stitch
skills.description: Embroidery that builds pictures from small X-shaped stitches.
skills.pitch: Count the squares, follow the chart, watch a picture appear.

skills.name: Punch needle
skills.description: Making looped, textured designs by punching yarn through fabric.
skills.pitch: Like embroidery, but faster and fluffier.

skills.name: Sewing
skills.description: Joining fabric by hand or machine to make clothes, bags and decor.
skills.pitch: From a tote bag to your own clothes, one seam at a time.

skills.name: Quilting
skills.description: Stitching layers of fabric together, often from pieced patches.
skills.pitch: Turn fabric scraps into something warm and full of stories.

skills.name: Weaving
skills.description: Interlacing threads on a loom to make fabric or wall hangings.
skills.pitch: Over, under, repeat — a small frame loom is enough to start.

skills.name: Macramé
skills.description: Knotting cord into decorative patterns and hangings.
skills.pitch: A handful of knots makes plant hangers and wall art.

skills.name: Felting
skills.description: Shaping wool fibres into solid forms or fabric.
skills.pitch: Poke soft wool into shapes — tiny animals are a classic start.

skills.name: Pottery
skills.description: Shaping clay into vessels and objects, then firing it.
skills.pitch: Get your hands muddy and make something you can actually use.

skills.name: Clay modeling
skills.description: Sculpting small objects from air-dry or modeling clay.
skills.pitch: Pottery without a kiln — air-dry clay works at the kitchen table.

skills.name: Polymer clay
skills.description: Making jewelry and miniatures from oven-baked polymer clay.
skills.pitch: Bright, bendable clay that hardens in a home oven.

skills.name: Pipe cleaner art
skills.description: Bending and twisting pipe cleaners into figures and decorations.
skills.pitch: Twist, bend, done — little creatures in minutes.

skills.name: Paper craft
skills.description: Cutting, folding and gluing paper into decorations and models.
skills.pitch: Scissors, glue and paper you already have are enough.

skills.name: Origami
skills.description: Folding a single sheet of paper into shapes without cutting.
skills.pitch: One square of paper, a few folds, a crane that stands up.

skills.name: Paper quilling
skills.description: Rolling and shaping thin paper strips into designs.
skills.pitch: Curl paper strips into flowers, swirls and tiny art.

skills.name: Collage
skills.description: Creating images by arranging and gluing cut paper and found materials.
skills.pitch: Cut, arrange, glue — old magazines become new art.

skills.name: Scrapbooking
skills.description: Arranging photos, notes and mementos into decorated pages.
skills.pitch: Keep your memories with paper, photos and a little glue.

skills.name: Journaling
skills.description: Keeping a handmade, decorated journal of thoughts and days.
skills.pitch: A notebook, a pen and ten minutes — no rules.

skills.name: Bookbinding
skills.description: Making and stitching your own books and notebooks by hand.
skills.pitch: Fold, stitch and bind a notebook that's entirely yours.

skills.name: Linocut
skills.description: Carving a design into linoleum and printing it with ink.
skills.pitch: Carve once, print again and again. Always cut away from your hand.

skills.name: Block printing
skills.description: Printing patterns on fabric or paper with carved blocks.
skills.pitch: Stamp patterns the way Indian textile printers have for centuries.

skills.name: Tie-dye
skills.description: Dyeing fabric in patterns by folding, twisting and binding it.
skills.pitch: Twist, tie, dye — every piece turns out different.

skills.name: Jewelry making
skills.description: Making necklaces, earrings and bracelets from beads, wire and more.
skills.pitch: Make the earrings you couldn't find in shops.

skills.name: Bead work
skills.description: Stringing and stitching beads into jewelry and decorations.
skills.pitch: Tiny beads, endless patterns, very satisfying.

skills.name: String art
skills.description: Making designs by wrapping thread around nails on a board.
skills.pitch: Nails, a board and thread make bold geometric art.

skills.name: Candle making
skills.description: Pouring wax into molds or containers to make candles.
skills.pitch: Melt, pour, wait — and your room smells like your choice.

skills.name: Soap making
skills.description: Making soap by hand, from melt-and-pour bases to cold process.
skills.pitch: Start with melt-and-pour; cold process uses lye and needs gloves.

skills.name: Resin art
skills.description: Casting or pouring epoxy resin into coasters, jewelry and art.
skills.pitch: Glossy, glassy pieces with flowers or pigments inside. Ventilate well.

skills.name: Woodworking
skills.description: Building objects from wood with hand or power tools.
skills.pitch: Make a shelf, a box or a spoon — learn tool safety first.

skills.name: Wood carving
skills.description: Shaping wood with knives and gouges, from spoons to figures.
skills.pitch: Whittle a spoon from a branch. Carve away from your body.

skills.name: Upcycling
skills.description: Turning old or discarded things into something new and useful.
skills.pitch: Jars, jeans and boxes get a second life.

skills.name: Rangoli
skills.description: Indian floor art made with colored powder, rice or flowers.
skills.pitch: Bright patterns at the doorstep for festivals and everyday welcomes.

skills.name: Mehndi
skills.description: Drawing intricate designs on skin with natural henna paste.
skills.pitch: Fine lines and flowing patterns. Practice on paper first.

skills.name: Madhubani painting
skills.description: Folk painting from Bihar with bold outlines and natural motifs.
skills.pitch: Fill every space with fish, peacocks and patterns.

skills.name: Warli art
skills.description: Tribal painting from Maharashtra made of simple geometric figures.
skills.pitch: Circles, triangles and lines tell whole stories.

skills.name: Lippan art
skills.description: Mud and mirror relief work from Kutch, Gujarat.
skills.pitch: Clay patterns studded with tiny mirrors that catch the light.

skills.name: Photography
skills.description: Making pictures with a camera or phone.
skills.pitch: The camera you already carry is enough to start.

skills.name: DIY
skills.description: Making and fixing things around the home yourself.
skills.pitch: Small projects that make your space more yours.
